query: I am in the last round of the interview process of my dream job. I spent so much time preparing for it and I'm really afraid that in the end it's all for nothing.
embedded: I am in the last round of the interview process of my dream job. I spent so much time preparing for it and I'm really afraid that in the end it's all for nothing. I keep thinking about how much I've put into this, and the idea that it might not pay off makes my stomach turn. I want it so badly that I can't even picture what I'd do if it fell through. I guess I'm just scared of finding out I'm not enough for it.

query: I think I'm in a toxic relationship, but I don't have the courage to break free.
embedded: I think I'm in a toxic relationship, but I don't have the courage to break free. I keep telling myself I should just do it, but then I think about being alone, or what I'd lose, and I freeze up again. Honestly I'm scared of the fallout more than I'm scared of staying unhappy, which probably says a lot. I just wish someone would make the decision easier for me.

query: I'm jealous of my friend's success.
embedded: I'm jealous of my friend's success. I say it so plainly but it still stings to admit. I think what bothers me is feeling like I'm being left behind, like their win somehow shows up my own stalling. I don't want to feel this way about someone I care about, but there it is.

query: I used to be very sportive and do a lot outdoor activities. But now with my knee problems I couldn't do those things that I used to enjoy. I feel sad about it.
embedded: I used to be very sportive and do a lot outdoor activities. But now with my knee problems I couldn't do those things that I used to enjoy. I feel sad about it. I guess what gets to me is losing a part of who I was, not just the activities themselves. I'm scared this is just how things are now, and I don't know how to feel like myself without them. I miss that version of me more than I expected.

query: My girlfriend broke up with me. Although I know it's the best outcome for both of us, I still can't let it go.
embedded: My girlfriend broke up with me. Although I know it's the best outcome for both of us, I still can't let it go. I keep telling myself it was the right call, but my chest doesn't believe it yet. I think I'm scared of what it means to actually let go, like I'll lose the last piece of her if I do. Part of me just wants the ache to stop without having to admit it's really over.

query: I always boast about my cool, digital normad lifestyle. But deep down I feel lonely.
embedded: I always boast about my cool, digital normad lifestyle. But deep down I feel lonely. I guess I say it so often because I want it to be true, or I want people to envy something instead of worry about me. But honestly I just want a place and people that know me, not another city where I'm impressive to strangers for a week and then forgotten.

query: My father has dementia and he does not recognize me anymore. That makes me sad beyond measure.
embedded: My father has dementia and he does not recognize me anymore. That makes me sad beyond measure. I guess what gets me is that he's still here, physically right in front of me, but the person who knew me my whole life is just gone. I keep wanting him to look at me the way he used to, even just once, and it hurts every time he doesn't. I think I'm also scared of what it means that someone can forget you completely, like all those years together just disappeared for him.

query: I worry sometimes that I have not been a good mum to my children because I spend much less time with them compared to other mums that work less.
embedded: I worry sometimes that I have not been a good mum to my children because I spend much less time with them compared to other mums that work less. I guess what I really want is to know they feel loved even if I'm not around as much, and it scares me that time is the thing I can't give more of. I think I compare myself to other mums and always come up short in my own head, even if the kids never actually say they feel neglected. Maybe I just need to hear that being present isn't only about hours, because right now I don't quite believe that myself.

query: My chronic back pain makes me bitter.
embedded: My chronic back pain makes me bitter. I think I said that because I'm tired of pretending I'm fine with it, tired of smiling through days when my body won't cooperate. I want people to understand it's not just pain, it's this constant low simmer of anger I can't switch off. And honestly, I'm scared it's changing who I am.

query: I can't seem to shake out the habit of doom-scrolling. I know it's pointless and bad for me. But I just keep doing it regardless.
embedded: I can't seem to shake out the habit of doom-scrolling. I know it's pointless and bad for me. But I just keep doing it regardless. I think I do it because it's easier than sitting with whatever's actually bothering me. There's some comfort in the numbness, even if I hate myself a little for it afterward. I guess I'm scared that if I stop, I'll just be alone with my own thoughts and I'm not sure I want that either.

query: I think I'm slowly burning out at work. All those deadlines, over and over again.
embedded: I think I'm slowly burning out at work. All those deadlines, over and over again. I keep telling myself I just need to push through one more deadline, but honestly I'm tired in a way that sleep doesn't fix anymore. I'm scared that if I don't slow down soon I'll just stop caring altogether, and that scares me more than the deadlines do. I just want one week where nothing is due.

query: I feel like I've not done enough for my family and that I'm failing them.
embedded: I feel like I've not done enough for my family and that I'm failing them. I think about all the things I haven't gotten around to, the time I haven't given, and it just sits heavy in my chest. I want them to feel taken care of, to know they matter more than anything else, and when I fall short of that it scares me. Maybe I'm being harder on myself than I need to be, but it's hard to shake the feeling that I should be doing more.

query: How do I stop fearing death
embedded: How do I stop fearing death I guess what I'm really asking is why it's gotten so loud in my head lately, why I can't just let it sit quietly in the back like other people seem to. I think I want someone to tell me it's normal, that wanting to feel okay doesn't mean I have to pretend I'm not scared. Maybe I just want to stop feeling like time is something chasing me instead of something I'm just living in.

query: How to deal with anger
embedded: How to deal with anger I guess I'm asking because something's been building up in me lately and I don't like how it comes out. I'm scared I'll snap at someone I care about, or that I'm just carrying this around and it's going to leak out sideways. I just want to not feel so on edge all the time.

query: On fame and being remembered after death
embedded: On fame and being remembered after death Why does it matter to me so much, really — I think I want to know that my life added up to something, that I didn't just pass through without leaving a mark. But if I'm honest, the fear underneath it is being forgotten completely, like it never happened at all.

query: on how to live with discomfort and pain
embedded: on how to live with discomfort and pain I guess I keep asking this because something's hurting right now and I don't know how to just sit with it without needing to fix it immediately. I think I'm afraid that if I don't find some way to manage it, it'll just keep wearing me down. Part of me wants to know there's a way through this that doesn't involve pretending I'm fine when I'm not.

query: How to be calm and clear-minded?
embedded: How to be calm and clear-minded? I guess I'm asking because right now I'm neither of those things, my head feels crowded and reactive and I don't like how that's been affecting the way I handle things. I want to stop feeling pulled in different directions every time something small goes wrong. Honestly I think I just want some sense of control back.

query: How to deal with change?
embedded: How to deal with change? I guess I'm asking because something's shifting right now and I don't feel ready for it. Part of me wants control back, wants to know how it'll turn out before it even happens. Honestly I think I'm just scared of losing what's familiar, even if I know staying the same isn't really an option.

query: Does Marcus say anything about wanting praise?
embedded: Does Marcus say anything about wanting praise? Why am I even asking that—I think I'm fishing for something to tell me it's okay to want people to notice what I do. I'd like to not care, but honestly the wanting is still there, and it bugs me that it bothers me this much.

query: What does Marcus teach about living in the present moment?
embedded: What does Marcus teach about living in the present moment? I guess what I'm really asking is why I keep drifting off into yesterday or tomorrow instead of just being here. I think I'm tired of feeling scattered, like I'm never fully in the thing I'm doing. I want some way to just settle down and stop chasing my own thoughts around.
